lines.text: خوف رسیدن باکابر وزهاد وترس رعایا از حکام ودزدی وقتل پنهانی وفتنه در میان
lines.en: fear reaching the grandees and ascetics, and the fear of the subjects from the rulers, and theft, and secret murder, and sedition among

lines.en: the Sayyids and judges, and the wrath of the great upon the rabble and ruffians, and the calamity of the wicked, and the rebellion of slaves and

lines.en: servants against their masters, and the capture of the Kharijites, and the exile of people from their dwellings and homelands, and the cheapness

lines.text: برده ومیوه وحدوث سرفه وزکام وجرب وبیماری اهل صلاح وحرارت واستیلای
lines.en: of slaves and fruit, and the occurrence of coughs and colds and scabies and the illness of the righteous, and heat, and the dominance of

lines.text: حدت براکابر وقتل در ناحیه مشرق وولایتی که منسوب بود بمشتری (تربیع مقابله
lines.en: sharpness upon the grandees, and murder in the eastern region and the province that was attributed to Jupiter. (The square [and] opposition

lines.text: شمس ومشتری) دلالت کند بر غضب پادشاه بر وزیری یا یکی از معارف ومصادر و
lines.en: of the Sun and Jupiter) indicates the wrath of the king upon a vizier or one of the acquaintances and sources, and

lines.text: توانگران واندوه علما وصدور وحسرت اکابر واشراف ومعزولی ارباب مناصب
lines.en: the wealthy, and the sorrow of the scholars and leaders, and the regret of the grandees and nobles, and the dismissal of the holders of offices,

lines.text: وتغییر وتبدیل دارالقضا وتفاوت نرخ طعام وفساد دارالضرب وخواستن طلب
lines.en: and the change and alteration of the courthouse, and the difference in the price of food, and the corruption of the mint, and the demanding of claims

lines.text: از ضرابان وظلم در صورت عدل وظهور خیانتها وطلب امرا واکابر ومیل حیوانات بگرما
lines.en: from the minters, and oppression in the form of justice, and the appearance of treacheries, and the demand of the emirs and grandees, and the inclination of animals to heat,

lines.text: وگرمی هوا در وقت وبیماری از صفرا وزحمت تشنگاران (اگر مقابله باشد) دلا
lines.en: and the heat of the air in time, and illness from yellow bile, and the trouble of the thirsty. (If it is an opposition) it indicates

lines.text: کند بر اندوه وزرا وعلما واعیان وخواست از مردم متمول وحیرت این طایفه
lines.en: the sorrow of the viziers and scholars and notables, and the demand from the wealthy people, and the bewilderment of this group,

lines.text: ومخوف بودن از جانب پادشاه ونیکی طعام وتفاوت نرخها وفساد نقود وگرمی
lines.en: and being fearful of the king, and the goodness of food, and the difference in prices, and the corruption of coins, and the heat

lines.text: هوا در وقت وهبوب ریاح عاصفه وموت یکی از معارف وتشنیع مردم در حق مخدوم
lines.en: of the air in time, and the blowing of violent winds, and the death of one of the acquaintances, and the reproach of people regarding the master,

lines.text: وارزانی طعام وضعف حال علما واشراف ومشغولی اهل صنایع بکار دنیوی واشکا
lines.en: and the cheapness of food, and the weakness of the condition of the scholars and nobles, and the preoccupation of the artisans with worldly affairs, and the difficulty

lines.text: شدن ستم وافتادن مهمات مردم بداوری اهل دیوان (واگر تربیع باشد) دلا
lines.en: of oppression, and the falling of people's important affairs to the judgment of the people of the court. (And if it is a square) it indicates

lines.text: کند بر قوت عظما وخصومت قضاة واهل شرع وعلما وارباب تدریس وغضب و
lines.en: the strength of the great, and the enmity of the judges and the people of the law and the scholars and the masters of teaching, and the wrath and

lines.text: نکوهش عظما وارباب مناصب بر این طایفه وخصومت بسبب درس وبحث ومناظره
lines.en: blame of the great and the holders of offices upon this group, and enmity because of lessons and discussion and debate

lines.text: در حضور سلاطین وحکام وتهمت بر اهل فضل وارباب تقوی ومجادله در دین و
lines.en: in the presence of sultans and rulers, and accusation against the people of virtue and the masters of piety, and disputation in religion and

lines.text: مذهب وتشهیر وتعزیر محتسبان وگرمی هوا در وقت وخیانت اهل دارالقضا وق
lines.en: sect, and the public shaming and punishment of the market inspectors, and the heat of the air in time, and the treachery of the people of the courthouse, and

lines.text: بکار داشتن سجلات ناحق ودروغ وفوت یکی از زهاد وصلحا وارسال رسل ورسایل
lines.en: the employment of unjust and false records, and the death of one of the ascetics and the righteous, and the sending of messengers and letters

lines.text: میان فرماندهان وناسازگاری (تربیع ومقابله زهره ومشتری) دلالت کند بر
lines.en: among the commanders, and incompatibility. (The square and opposition of Venus and Jupiter) indicates

lines.text: اشفتگی ازواج ورغبت علما واهل ورع وارباب شریعت بلهو وطرب وزینت
lines.en: the confusion of spouses, and the inclination of the scholars and the people of piety and the masters of the Sharia to amusement and joy and adornment

lines.text: وسیر وگشت وطلب حقوق شرعیه وفاش شدن راز پادشاهان وتهمت بر یکی
lines.en: and strolling and touring, and the demand for legal rights, and the revelation of the secrets of kings, and accusation against one

sections.en: Square and opposition of the Sun and Jupiter

summary.headline: Planetary Squares and Oppositions
summary.text: Astrological interpretations of the Sun–Jupiter square and opposition, followed by the Venus–Jupiter square and opposition: political unrest, illness, heat, price changes, coin corruption, court disputes, and effects on scholars, rulers, judges, and religious authorities.
